title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
About the role:

The Demand Generation Manager is responsible for ensuring that clients receive high-quality marketing execution that drives measurable results. Whether through points our hours, this role ensures work is delivered efficiently and transparently based on each client’s contract.

This role requires strong strategic thinking, project management, and client relationship skills to ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, executed, and optimized. You will act as the primary contact for clients, overseeing campaign execution, aligning resources, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:Client Strategy & Execution

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment on objectives.

● Guide quarterly strategy calls , translating business goals into structured marketing initiatives.

● Define and prioritize client deliverables , ensuring efficient execution.

● Proactively provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance marketing performance.

Project & Resource Management

● Oversee the execution of marketing campaigns , coordinating with Specialists to achieve desired results.

● Monitor progress on deliverables , ensuring projects stay within the allocated scope.

● Manage deadlines, approvals, and revisions , ensuring seamless project completion.

● Work with internal teams to optimize workflows and improve efficiency in marketing execution.

Performance & Optimization

● Track and analyze marketing performance , identifying areas for optimization.

● Collaborate with channel heads and Account Directors to ensure high quality deliverables get produced and contribute to client goals.

● Regularly review client satisfaction and engagement , proactively addressing potential issues.

● Identify opportunities for upselling additional services that align with client needs.

● Collaborate with the Growth Manager to ensure high client retention and continued success.

Success Metrics

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the following key performance indicators:

● Client point burden , ensuring each client remains on track based on the amount of points/hours purchased.

● Client goals, ensuring we are hitting the pre-defined targets set forth to define specific outcomes from the engagement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in-house in B2B digital marketing or demand generation, ideally within software and technology.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid media channels and optimizing digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, digital attribution models, and revenue-oriented KPIs.
  • Excellent project management skills; capable of managing internal projects and multiple external vendors.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of attribution models and proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, DreamData, or similar.
  • Familiarity with technical tools like Google Tag Manager, and Optimizely or VWO.
  • The ability to self-direct and self-start and work independently as well as within and across teams.
  • Hands-on experience in using marketing automation technology (HubSpot) and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.
  • CV and LinkedIn profile in English showcasing experience in chronological order.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Prior experience in a growth-stage or scale-up SaaS business.
  • Familiarity with content personalization, dynamic content, or account-based web experiences.
  • Experience with SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g., Domo, Looker, Tableau, etc.).

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

Lilo Social is seeking a Creative Strategist to lead performance-driven creative strategy across a portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will own the end-to-end creative testing engine—from research and messaging frameworks to briefs, storyboards, conversion rate optimization ideas, and ongoing iteration—helping clients consistently find creative winners and scale spend profitably. This is a highly cross-functional role where you will partner closely with design, video, media buying, and account teams while working directly with clients to set creative direction, align on priorities, and build repeatable roadmaps for growth.


What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, repeatable creative testing system running across your client portfolio with consistent velocity to new concepts, angles, and iterations
  • Creative insights that translate into measurable performance improvements including higher click-through rates, conversion rates, lower customer acquisition costs, and scalable winning campaigns
  • Strong client trust in your strategic point of view, demonstrated through proactive communication, data-backed recommendations, and leadership in creative direction
  • Elevated internal creative standards through contributions to team training, standard operating procedures, and systems that improve output quality and speed


Responsibilities

  • Lead research and insights by mining customer reviews, competitor ads libraries, audience pain points, and product differentiators to identify winning angles and positioning strategies
  • Own creative testing strategy by building and managing structured testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses, variables to test, iteration plans, and learning agendas
  • Create world-class creative briefs that transform insights into crisp, actionable direction for designers and video editors including hooks, messaging frameworks, visual concepts, format specifications, and success criteria
  • Direct performance storytelling by mapping the customer journey from awareness through consideration to purchase and translating it into compelling paid social concepts
  • Build UGC and production guidance including shot lists, video scripts, creator direction, and content planning that supports performance-oriented execution
  • Manage creator relationships by sourcing, coordinating, and guiding content creators to produce on-brief, performance-oriented content that aligns with testing objectives
  • Write high-performing ad copy including primary text, headlines, hooks, and on-screen text that aligns with strategic goals and testing frameworks
  • Collaborate on conversion rate optimization by partnering with teams on landing page improvements and conversion-focused messaging updates
  • Track and communicate performance by monitoring key performance indicators by concept and angle, synthesizing learnings, and reporting insights to internal teams and clients
  • Develop inspiration and competitor boards to inform creative direction and identify market trends and opportunities
  • Lead copy across paid ads for in-ad copy and headline variations that drive engagement and conversions


Requirements

  • 1-2 years of experience in ecommerce or performance marketing with strong preference for direct-to-consumer brand experience
  • Proven track record of paid social creative strategy with expertise in Meta Ads (required) and familiarity with TikTok or YouTube (preferred)
  • Strong grasp of creative testing methodology including hypothesis development, structured testing frameworks, iteration velocity, and performance analysis
  • Experience working with design and video teams from brief development through execution to iteration, with ability to provide clear, actionable creative direction
  • Data-fluent approach with comfort using performance metrics including click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend to make decisions and guide priorities
  • Deep understanding of customer psychology, marketing funnels, and storytelling principles that drive direct response performance
  • Excellent copywriting skills across multiple formats including hooks, scripts, ad copy, and landing pages with proven ability to write persuasive, conversion-focused content
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, quality control processes, and ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously
  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Google Analytics, Figma, Motion, and collaboration tools including Slack, Asana, or Notion


Nice to Have

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

title: SAP FICO Consultant – ICT / Trading Partner / Healthcare
description:
We are looking for a Senior SAP FICO & SD Consultant to support and enhance a highly customized Trading Partner (TP) / Intercompany Trading (ICT) solution, with strong exposure to Healthcare financial processes (HCO/HCP).

This is a great opportunity to work in a complex, bespoke SAP environment, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, BAU teams, and FUSION teams, and playing a key role in compliance, audits, and continuous improvements.

What You’ll Do

Trading Partner / Intercompany (Bespoke Solution)

  • Support and enhance a non‑standard, highly customized Trading Partner solution
  • Understand and manage end‑to‑end bespoke business processes
  • Translate complex intercompany and TP requirements into SAP functional solutions
  • Support audit, compliance, testing, and documentation activities
  • Collaborate with FUSION teams on enhancements and regulatory changes


SAP FICO (Finance & Controlling)

  • FI: GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting
  • CO: Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, CO‑PA
  • Strong hands‑on experience with:

  • Pricing

  • Support UAT, regression testing, and solution validation
  • Work closely with ABAP teams on developments and fixes

  • Deep knowledge of Trading Partner / Intercompany (ICT) accounting
  • Experience supporting audits and regulated environments
  • Healthcare domain knowledge (HCO/HCP) is highly valued
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills

Nice to Have

  • S/4HANA transformation or migration experience
  • Experience in global / multinational projects

title: Ad Operations Specialist
description:
Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist



AdLib is looking for a DSP Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist to support our brand and agency partners by ensuring flawless campaign setup, trafficking, QA, and delivery execution across multiple

programmatic platforms. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience implementing and

maintaining campaigns across DSPs like BeesWax, Yahoo, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, and similar.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Execute end-to-end trafficking and setup across multiple DSPs, including QA and launch

readiness.

• Manage pacing and delivery to ensure budgets and flight dates remain on track.

• Perform detailed QA across targeting, creatives, tracking, and measurement prior to launch.

• Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues, tracking errors, creative rejections, and platform-level discrepancies.

• Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns are implemented

correctly and on time.

• Maintain accurate documentation, naming conventions, and operational workflows across platforms.

• Support reporting needs by ensuring campaign data is consistent and properly structured.

• Stay up to date on DSP requirements, ad operations best practices, and evolving programmatic standards.



Whats You Bring

• 2+ years of experience in ad operations, trafficking, or execution across multiple DSPs (BeesWax, Xandr, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, etc.).

• Strong understanding of trafficking workflows, pacing, and QA processes in programmatic

advertising.

• Experience troubleshooting delivery, tracking, and technical issues across platforms.

• Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, Appsflyer, and Google Analytics is a plus.

• Detail-oriented mindset with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple active campaigns in a fast-paced, remote work environment.



What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (dependent on region)
  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible, remote-first culture
  • Coworking space allowance
  • Gym membership reimbursement

description:

Estamos há 12 anos no mercado, e em nossa história, temos muitos aprendizados e conquistas, que nos ajudaram a construir uma cultura sólida, com base em três pilares: o Cuidar, Imaginar e Simplificar. Tudo isso pensando em nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e na tecnologia.


Se você se identifica com valores como: Simplicidade, Agilidade, Confiança, Inovação e Experiência do Cliente , já está há um passo à frente! Então, continue lendo para conhecer mais sobre essa oportunidade que pode mudar sua carreira!


➡️ Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Manager para atuar na frente de Clientes Estratégicos , liderando a entrega e evolução de soluções em contextos de alta complexidade, múltiplas integrações e forte impacto comercial.


Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar um portfólio de clientes relevantes, atuando de forma end-to-end — desde o entendimento do problema até a entrega em produção — com responsabilidade direta sobre o sucesso das iniciativas.


Aqui, não buscamos um perfil focado apenas em backlog ou execução. Procuramos alguém com ownership, capaz de equilibrar demandas de clientes, viabilidade técnica e objetivos de negócio , tomando decisões e conduzindo stakeholders em cenários de pressão e ambiguidade.


No seu dia a dia estas serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar o backlog e as entregas de múltiplos clientes estratégicos simultaneamente, garantindo alinhamento com valor de negócio e viabilidade técnica.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre cliente, time técnico e áreas internas, garantindo clareza, alinhamento e fluidez na comunicação.
  • Traduzir necessidades complexas de clientes em soluções estruturadas, considerando impacto, dependências e escalabilidade.
  • Negociar escopo, prazos e trade-offs constantemente, equilibrando velocidade de entrega com qualidade da solução.
  • Mapear integrações, fluxos e dependências entre sistemas internos e parceiros externos.
  • Acompanhar a evolução das entregas, garantindo previsibilidade e mitigação de riscos.
  • Atuar de forma proativa na resolução de problemas, removendo impedimentos e destravando decisões.
  • Contribuir para transformar entregas em cases comerciais relevantes, potencializando o impacto estratégico dos clientes atendidos.


Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência como PM ou PO em produtos digitais, com atuação em contextos complexos e múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Vivência em ambientes com forte interação com clientes (B2B), incluindo negociação de escopo, prazos e expectativas.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas iniciativas simultaneamente sem perder visão de prioridade e impacto.
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para discutir soluções com engenharia, incluindo conceitos de APIs, integrações, frontend, backend e arquitetura.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises e consultas em bases de dados (SQL, MongoDB ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Jira, Confluence ou equivalentes.
  • Excelente comunicação, com habilidade para transitar entre áreas técnicas, comerciais e operacionais.


Perfil que buscamos:

  • Pessoa com senso de responsabilidade sobre resultado, não apenas entrega.
  • Capacidade de puxar stakeholders e liderar discussões, sem depender de direcionamento constante.
  • Habilidade para tomar decisões em cenários de ambiguidade e pressão.
  • Visão sistêmica, entendendo impactos além do escopo imediato.
  • Equilíbrio entre pragmatismo (entregar) e qualidade (sustentar no longo prazo).
  • Organização e clareza para lidar com múltiplos clientes e frentes ao mesmo tempo.


Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência com integrações com adquirentes, gateways de pagamento, TEF ou sistemas fiscais.
  • Vivência com parceiros externos e integrações complexas (ex: redes, eventos, grandes operações).
  • Experiência com PDVs, ERP de varejo, soluções para food service ou eventos.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e capacidade de transformar entregas em aprendizados e oportunidades de evolução.


O que oferecemos:

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos com alto impacto no negócio e visibilidade interna.
  • Contato direto com grandes clientes e participação ativa na construção de soluções relevantes.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e espaço para tomada de decisão.
  • Time técnico experiente e colaborativo.
  • Flexibilidade de atuação (remoto ou híbrido).


Mais informações:

  • Possuir CNPJ ativo (nosso modelo de contratação é PJ - Prestador de Serviço).

title: Coordenador de marketing
description:
We are looking for contractor support to strengthen creative workflow operations. This person would not be focused on creative production itself, but on helping requests move efficiently through intake, scoping, setup, and handoff, while also supporting workflow improvements in Asana .


Responsibilities


  • Intake flow and request readiness: Review, organize, and prepare incoming requests after triage so work can move to the next step efficiently. Help reduce the backlog of post-triage tickets and structure requests that have been triaged but still need scoping before assignment or execution.
  • Task setup in Asana: Create and maintain clear, complete task setups in Asana — including descriptions, owners, dependencies, due dates, and supporting materials needed for smooth handoffs. Ensure every task is set up consistently and accurately.
  • Workflow consistency across the team: Help ensure requests are routed, documented, and handed off in a consistent way, reducing friction and rework across the team.
  • Workflow support for senior creative team members: Take on administrative workflow tasks currently sitting with senior design leadership, freeing those team members to focus on project leadership, team development, and higher-value initiatives.
  • Asana optimization: Build and maintain reports, rules, and automations in Asana that improve visibility, operational efficiency, and consistency across the team's workflow.
  • Work-in-progress visibility and reporting: Support tracking and reporting on outstanding requests, bottlenecks, and workflow needs — giving the team a clearer, more reliable view of what's in flight.
  • Scalable workflow support structure: Help establish a support model that can grow with the team as request volume increases and as creative and content operations become more closely integrated.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience (+5 years);
  • Fluent in English ;
  • Experience in operational workflow management, ideally within creative or content teams;
  • Strong command of Asana — including task creation, rules, reports, and automations;
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational instincts;
  • Ability to spot bottlenecks and improve processes proactively;
  • Clear communicator with a track record of clean, context-rich handoffs;
  • Self-directed, execution-oriented, and comfortable working with ambiguity.


Location: Home Office

PJ Contract - Salary: Negotiable

Start Availability: Immediate


Come and join the BEST IT TEAM!

description:

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.


This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

  • Local de Trabalho: Remoto

O que buscamos?


Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Suporte a Aplicações SAP experiente, especializado em Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) e SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM), uma aplicação nativa em nuvem projetada para o SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.


Esta função tem como foco fornecer suporte de aplicação de Nível 2 / Nível 3 para o processamento completo (end-to-end) de faturas de fornecedores, garantindo operações estáveis, tratamento eficiente de exceções e melhoria contínua dos processos em ambientes SAP integrados.


Conhecimentos e Competências Necessárias:


  • Experiência com S/4 HANA e SAP Activate;
  • Inglês avançado (Mandatório);
  • Experiência em suporte a aplicações SAP, com forte atuação em Vendor Invoice Management;
  • Experiência prática (hands-on) no suporte ao SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM) em ambiente produtivo;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de ITSM.


Responsabilidades:


  • Suporte a Aplicações & Gestão de Incidentes:

Fornecer suporte a aplicações para SAP Vendor Invoice Management e SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM) em múltiplas unidades de negócio e códigos de empresa.


  • Solucionar problemas e resolver incidentes relacionados a:

Recebimento de faturas (invoice ingestion);

Extração via OCR e erros de validação;

Problemas de status de faturas;

Workflow, aprovações e tratamento de exceções.

Realizar análise de causa raiz (root cause analysis) e implementar correções sustentáveis em conformidade com SLAs e processos ITIL.

Oferecer suporte em períodos críticos de negócio sob demanda.


  • Configuração & Melhorias no CIM:

Configurar e dar suporte às definições de processamento de faturas no SAP Central Invoice Management, incluindo:

Tipos de fatura e serviços de processamento

Regras de negócio e validações

Configuração de workflows e aprovações

Apoiar melhorias e solicitações de mudança relacionadas à eficiência, conformidade e automação do processamento de faturas.


  • Colaborar com equipes ABAP e de integração para:

Interfaces entre o CIM e sistemas SAP backend

Tratamento de erros e monitoramento de fluxos de entrada de faturas


  • Integração & Processamento de Faturas de Entrada:

Dar suporte às integrações de faturas provenientes de:

SAP S/4HANA

Sistemas externos

Monitorar e dar suporte aos agendamentos de importação de faturas.

Auxiliar na resolução de falhas de integração e inconsistências de dados entre o CIM e sistemas ERP conectados.


  • Colaboração com Finanças & Negócio:

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Contas a Pagar, Finanças e Compras.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante a entrevista técnica com o cliente.

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Part-time | Full-time | REMOTE

  • Monitor local trends and market information in the local language region, synchronize with headquarters, and provide localized perspective analysis.

  • Proactive thinking and execution ability, with strong delivery, business negotiation skills, and responsibility.
  • Knowledge of the Portuguese-speaking region’s Web3 ecosystem, with successful PR collaboration or market promotion cases in vertical media.

Working at BingX

  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Account Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time | Core hours: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM EST


Macedo Marketing is a performance-driven paid ads agency working with eCommerce and digital product brands in tier-one markets.


We’re hiring an Account Manager who can own client communication end-to-end, keep things calm when results fluctuate, and drive retention through clarity, trust, and solid execution.


About Macedo Marketing

  • We help eCommerce and digital product brands grow through paid advertising and creative strategy.
  • We’re direct, high standards, and process-driven. We care about results, but we also care about how we get them: honest communication, clear ownership, and no drama.
  • You’ll work closely with media buyers and creatives, but you’ll own the client relationship.


The Role

  • As an Account Manager, your job is to keep 15–20 clients aligned, confident, and moving forward. This is not a “smile and reassure” role. It’s a client-trust role.
  • You’ll lead client calls, handle day-to-day communication, translate performance into clear updates, and make sure the internal team is aligned on what matters most for each account.


Mission

Ensure clients feel confident, informed, and supported while achieving strong performance outcomes, leading to long-term retention and account growth.


Success looks like

  • Clients stay longer because they trust you
  • Issues get handled early, not after clients complain
  • Performance dips don’t turn into chaos
  • Clients understand what’s happening and what’s next
  • Upsell opportunities are spotted and surfaced responsibly


What You’ll Do

  • Own client communication and calls for your book of accounts (15–20 clients)
  • Run weekly or bi-weekly calls with clear structure, next steps, and accountability
  • Translate performance updates into clear, honest client communication


When performance dips:

  • Calmly explain the situation to the client with facts and context
  • Push internally for clarity and corrective action with the media buyer/creative team
  • Keep timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups clean and tracked
  • Make sure client questions don’t sit unanswered
  • Spot upsell and expansion opportunities and flag them internally
  • Collect testimonials / positive feedback at the right moments


This Will Be For You If…

  • You have 3+ years in account management / client success (agency experience is a strong plus)
  • You’re native or fully fluent in English and comfortable leading client calls
  • You’re calm under pressure and don’t take client stress personally
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and move fast on important tasks
  • You don’t overpromise to “make the client happy” — you align internally first
  • You’re curious about paid ads and want to deepen your understanding of Meta/Google fundamentals
  • You can handle a client load of 15–20 without dropping quality


Do Not Apply If…

  • You tend to procrastinate or take too long to handle time-sensitive issues
  • You leave client questions unanswered or avoid uncomfortable conversations
  • You “smooth things over” by making commitments without internal approval
  • You’re not interested in learning the basics of paid ads and how our delivery process works
  • You need constant supervision to stay organized


Why Join Macedo Marketing

  • Clear expectations and ownership: you’ll know what “good” tells like here
  • Direct access to leadership: fast decisions, no corporate layers
  • High standards, low drama: we care about performance and professionalism
  • 100% remote: work from anywhere, as long as you overlap 8 AM–4 PM EST
  • Growth path: this role can develop into a Senior AM / Client Lead position
  • Compensation is competitive and based on experience. We’ll ask for expectations in the application.


How to Apply

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • We’ll send a short application form to shortlisted candidates
  • First interview for standout applications
  • We move quickly with the right people.

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager
description:
About us:

At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.


Overview:

One of our fast-growing US clients is looking for a versatile SEO marketer with a strong Growth foundation and proven experience running B2B campaigns. In this role, you'll own the search strategy, drive measurable pipeline growth, and support high-impact marketing initiatives across the funnel.


You’ll spend about 60% of your time on SEO (including AI-driven SEO) and 40% on broader growth projects . From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to launching targeted ads on LinkedIn and Google, you’ll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly.


This is a high-agency, high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants room to grow.


Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve the SEO strategy to improve rankings, visibility, and conversions across both Google search and large language models.
  • Conduct keyword research, optimize on-page content, lead technical SEO improvements, and run AI-SEO experiments.
  • Report weekly on performance, key insights, and recommended actions.
  • Launch, manage, and optimize B2B campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads to drive qualified leads.
  • Write high-converting copy for ads, landing pages, and growth experiments.
  • Support awareness and demand-gen initiatives, including webinar promotion, content refreshes, and campaign execution.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to execute cross-functional growth projects.


Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2B environments.
  • Proven success in SEO, including technical SEO, content optimization, and AI-driven SEO strategies.
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads .
  • Proficiency with SEO tools such as SEMrush , Ahrefs , or equivalents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong copywriting ability, especially for ads and landing pages.
  • High ownership mindset, you prioritize effectively, execute independently, and move fast.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Startup experience or comfort operating in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page optimization.

title: Business Development Manager (SaaS Subscriptions)
description:
Company Description

A Hiring Group is dedicated to connecting companies with exceptional talent, empowering organizations of all sizes to succeed. Specializing in staffing across industries including software development, marketing, customer service, administration, and executive roles, we focus on building strong teams. We pride ourselves on identifying and placing candidates who align with the unique needs of each business.


Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager with a strong background in SaaS subscription models to drive revenue growth and expand our customer base. This role will focus on acquiring new clients, nurturing long-term relationships, and maximizing recurring revenue through subscription-based solutions. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in SaaS sales cycles, subscription pricing strategies, and customer lifecycle management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to grow SaaS subscription revenue
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification to closing and onboarding
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategies focused on subscription growth
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders
  • Drive recurring revenue through new sales, renewals, upselling, and cross-selling
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and customer success teams to align on customer acquisition and retention strategies
  • Analyze market trends, competitor offerings, and customer needs to refine sales approaches
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations and articulate value propositions effectively
  • Negotiate subscription agreements, pricing models, and contract terms
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and CRM data


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in business development or sales, with at least 2 years in SaaS or subscription-based products
  • Proven success in selling SaaS solutions and meeting or exceeding revenue targets
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics such as ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, and LTV
  • Experience managing subscription sales cycles and customer lifecycle strategies
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in B2B / B2C SaaS environments (mid-market or enterprise)
  • Familiarity with subscription billing systems and pricing models (tiered, usage-based, freemium)
  • Experience working in fast-paced or high-growth environments
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills

title: Orçamentista
description:
Orçamentista (Estimator)


Objetivo da Função

Experiência na elaboração de orçamentos técnicos em projetos de fachadas e building envelope, com foco em sistemas de ACM e Attachment System, vidro arquitetônico e soluções de fachada. O profissional atuará diretamente na análise de documentos de projeto, levantamento de quantidades e preparação de propostas competitivas para novos projetos.

Responsabilidades
  • Analisar projetos, especificações técnicas e documentos de licitação.
  • Realizar levantamento de quantidades (takeoffs) para sistemas de fachada, incluindo ACM, Vidro arquitetônico e outros sistemas de envelope.
  • Preparar orçamentos detalhados considerando materiais e custos indiretos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de projetos e compras para obter cotações de fornecedores.
  • Avaliar diferentes soluções técnicas para otimizar custos e competitividade das propostas.
  • Preparar e organizar pré-propostas comerciais e documentação de suporte.
  • Participar da revisão de escopo e alinhamento técnico com clientes e parceiros quando necessário.
  • Manter banco de dados atualizado de custos, fornecedores e referências de projetos anteriores.
Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada como orçamentista na indústria de fachadas de mais de 5 anos , preferencialmente com sistemas de ACM, vidro arquitetônico e sistemas de fachada em geral .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e projetos arquitetônicos.
  • Experiência com levantamento de quantidades (material takeoff).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e capacidade analítica.
  • Inglês avançado , pois todos os documentos e projetos e reuniões são em inglês.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com equipes técnicas e fornecedores.
  • O trabalho é 100% home-office.

description:
SUA INSCRIÇÃO SÓ SERÁ AVALIADA SE VOCÊ PREENCHER O FORMULÁRIO:


SOBRE A MDASS


Somos uma agência Google Partner Premier 2024 e 2025 em franco crescimento fundada no fim de 2022 e já atendemos mais de 150 clientes de diversos setores e tamanhos. Prezamos por uma gestão baseada no método CARE, exclusivo da MDASS, para gerir tráfego pago.


Saiba mais aqui:
