• Strong understanding of trafficking workflows, pacing, and QA processes in programmatic

advertising.

• Experience troubleshooting delivery, tracking, and technical issues across platforms.

• Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, Appsflyer, and Google Analytics is a plus.

• Detail-oriented mindset with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple active campaigns in a fast-paced, remote work environment.



What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (dependent on region)
  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible, remote-first culture
  • Coworking space allowance
  • Gym membership reimbursement

Join us at AdLib and help agencies and brands scale their programmatic media buying smarter, faster, and more profitably

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Ad Operations Specialist
description:
Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist



AdLib is looking for a DSP Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist to support our brand and agency partners by ensuring flawless campaign setup, trafficking, QA, and delivery execution across multiple

programmatic platforms. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience implementing and

maintaining campaigns across DSPs like BeesWax, Yahoo, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, and similar.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Execute end-to-end trafficking and setup across multiple DSPs, including QA and launch

readiness.

• Manage pacing and delivery to ensure budgets and flight dates remain on track.

• Perform detailed QA across targeting, creatives, tracking, and measurement prior to launch.

• Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues, tracking errors, creative rejections, and platform-level discrepancies.

• Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns are implemented

correctly and on time.

• Maintain accurate documentation, naming conventions, and operational workflows across platforms.

• Support reporting needs by ensuring campaign data is consistent and properly structured.

• Stay up to date on DSP requirements, ad operations best practices, and evolving programmatic standards.



Whats You Bring

• 2+ years of experience in ad operations, trafficking, or execution across multiple DSPs (BeesWax, Xandr, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, etc.).

• Strong understanding of trafficking workflows, pacing, and QA processes in programmatic

advertising.

• Experience troubleshooting delivery, tracking, and technical issues across platforms.

• Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, Appsflyer, and Google Analytics is a plus.

• Detail-oriented mindset with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple active campaigns in a fast-paced, remote work environment.



What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (dependent on region)
  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible, remote-first culture
  • Coworking space allowance
  • Gym membership reimbursement
  • Mobile phone plan reimbursement

Join us at AdLib and help agencies and brands scale their programmatic media buying smarter, faster, and more profitably

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação II
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.


Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista


Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.
  • Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.
  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.
  • Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.
  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado – Será necessário para se comunicar com times internacionais, participar de reuniões técnicas e colaborar em projetos globais.
  • Formação acadêmica na área de computação – Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os testes automatizados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.
  • Tech Stack: Python, Java, Golang, AWS (EKS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Git, Jenkins, Grafana


Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: Especialista Banco de Dados Oracle/AWS - 132298
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional Especialista DBA Oracle com experiência em Cloud AWS e vivência no setor bancário para atuação remota.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS.
  • Validar o DynamoDB AWS como mecanismo de persistência para cargas críticas, avaliando aderência a requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Desenhar e validar o sincronismo entre DynamoDB e Oracle (near-real-time), garantindo: Linha contábil;
  • Reconciliação Geração de extratos;
  • Definir e aplicar modelagem de dados e padrões de uso para NoSQL e relacional.
  • Projetar e acompanhar pipelines de eventos para integração entre sistemas.
  • Executar e analisar testes de performance, concorrência e volume.
  • Executar e analisar testes de consistência de dados entre DynamoDB e Oracle.
  • Monitorar ambientes, identificar gargalos e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Atuar em incidentes críticos, com análise de causa raiz.
  • Garantir segurança, controle de acesso e rastreabilidade dos dados.
  • Documentar arquiteturas, decisões técnicas e boas práticas.
  • Modelagem e padrões
  • Definir padrões de modelagem para DynamoDB (partitions, índices, acesso).
  • Alinhar modelagem Oracle × DynamoDB considerando consistência e performance.
  • Definir padrões de versionamento e rastreabilidade de dados.
  • Pipeline de eventos
  • Apoiar o desenho de pipelines baseados em eventos para sincronismo de dados.
  • Garantir confiabilidade, ordenação (quando necessário) e tratamento de falhas.
  • Validar estratégias de reprocessamento e compensação.
  • Testes de performance
  • Planejar e executar testes de carga, estresse e concorrência.
  • Avaliar escalabilidade do DynamoDB frente a picos de acesso.
  • Comparar resultados com requisitos de negócio e SLAs.
  • Testes de consistência
  • Garantir consistência dos dados entre Oracle e DynamoDB.
  • Apoiar processos de reconciliação e auditoria.
  • Validar comportamento em cenários de falha e recuperação.

Requisitos :


  • Experiência com Oracle: Administração de ambientes críticos Performance e tuning Backup, restore e alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência prática com AWS DynamoDB: Modelagem NoSQL orientada a acesso Índices globais e locais;
  • Monitoramento e análise de custo/performance;
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta concorrência e grande volume;
  • Conhecimentos em Linux;
  • Capacidade de análise e troubleshooting avançado.


Desejável:


  • Certificação AWS e/ou Oracle;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Vivência em ambientes financeiros, contábeis ou regulados;
  • Conhecimento de automação e scripts;
  • Experiência com práticas de resiliência e tolerância a falhas.

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

title: Account Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time | Core hours: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM EST


Macedo Marketing is a performance-driven paid ads agency working with eCommerce and digital product brands in tier-one markets.


We’re hiring an Account Manager who can own client communication end-to-end, keep things calm when results fluctuate, and drive retention through clarity, trust, and solid execution.


About Macedo Marketing

  • We help eCommerce and digital product brands grow through paid advertising and creative strategy.
  • We’re direct, high standards, and process-driven. We care about results, but we also care about how we get them: honest communication, clear ownership, and no drama.
  • You’ll work closely with media buyers and creatives, but you’ll own the client relationship.


The Role

  • As an Account Manager, your job is to keep 15–20 clients aligned, confident, and moving forward. This is not a “smile and reassure” role. It’s a client-trust role.
  • You’ll lead client calls, handle day-to-day communication, translate performance into clear updates, and make sure the internal team is aligned on what matters most for each account.


Mission

Ensure clients feel confident, informed, and supported while achieving strong performance outcomes, leading to long-term retention and account growth.


Success looks like

  • Clients stay longer because they trust you
  • Issues get handled early, not after clients complain
  • Performance dips don’t turn into chaos
  • Clients understand what’s happening and what’s next
  • Upsell opportunities are spotted and surfaced responsibly


What You’ll Do

  • Own client communication and calls for your book of accounts (15–20 clients)
  • Run weekly or bi-weekly calls with clear structure, next steps, and accountability
  • Translate performance updates into clear, honest client communication


When performance dips:

  • Calmly explain the situation to the client with facts and context
  • Push internally for clarity and corrective action with the media buyer/creative team
  • Keep timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups clean and tracked
  • Make sure client questions don’t sit unanswered
  • Spot upsell and expansion opportunities and flag them internally
  • Collect testimonials / positive feedback at the right moments


This Will Be For You If…

  • You have 3+ years in account management / client success (agency experience is a strong plus)
  • You’re native or fully fluent in English and comfortable leading client calls
  • You’re calm under pressure and don’t take client stress personally
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and move fast on important tasks
  • You don’t overpromise to “make the client happy” — you align internally first
  • You’re curious about paid ads and want to deepen your understanding of Meta/Google fundamentals
  • You can handle a client load of 15–20 without dropping quality


Do Not Apply If…

  • You tend to procrastinate or take too long to handle time-sensitive issues
  • You leave client questions unanswered or avoid uncomfortable conversations
  • You “smooth things over” by making commitments without internal approval
  • You’re not interested in learning the basics of paid ads and how our delivery process works
  • You need constant supervision to stay organized


Why Join Macedo Marketing

  • Clear expectations and ownership: you’ll know what “good” tells like here
  • Direct access to leadership: fast decisions, no corporate layers
  • High standards, low drama: we care about performance and professionalism
  • 100% remote: work from anywhere, as long as you overlap 8 AM–4 PM EST
  • Growth path: this role can develop into a Senior AM / Client Lead position
  • Compensation is competitive and based on experience. We’ll ask for expectations in the application.


How to Apply

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • We’ll send a short application form to shortlisted candidates
  • First interview for standout applications
  • We move quickly with the right people.

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Coordenador de marketing
description:
We are looking for contractor support to strengthen creative workflow operations. This person would not be focused on creative production itself, but on helping requests move efficiently through intake, scoping, setup, and handoff, while also supporting workflow improvements in Asana .


Responsibilities


  • Intake flow and request readiness: Review, organize, and prepare incoming requests after triage so work can move to the next step efficiently. Help reduce the backlog of post-triage tickets and structure requests that have been triaged but still need scoping before assignment or execution.
  • Task setup in Asana: Create and maintain clear, complete task setups in Asana — including descriptions, owners, dependencies, due dates, and supporting materials needed for smooth handoffs. Ensure every task is set up consistently and accurately.
  • Workflow consistency across the team: Help ensure requests are routed, documented, and handed off in a consistent way, reducing friction and rework across the team.
  • Workflow support for senior creative team members: Take on administrative workflow tasks currently sitting with senior design leadership, freeing those team members to focus on project leadership, team development, and higher-value initiatives.
  • Asana optimization: Build and maintain reports, rules, and automations in Asana that improve visibility, operational efficiency, and consistency across the team's workflow.
  • Work-in-progress visibility and reporting: Support tracking and reporting on outstanding requests, bottlenecks, and workflow needs — giving the team a clearer, more reliable view of what's in flight.
  • Scalable workflow support structure: Help establish a support model that can grow with the team as request volume increases and as creative and content operations become more closely integrated.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience (+5 years);
  • Fluent in English ;
  • Experience in operational workflow management, ideally within creative or content teams;
  • Strong command of Asana — including task creation, rules, reports, and automations;
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational instincts;
  • Ability to spot bottlenecks and improve processes proactively;
  • Clear communicator with a track record of clean, context-rich handoffs;
  • Self-directed, execution-oriented, and comfortable working with ambiguity.


Location: Home Office

PJ Contract - Salary: Negotiable

Start Availability: Immediate

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary


Data Meaning is a front-runner in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics consulting, renowned for our high-quality consulting services throughout the US and beyond. Our expertise lies in delivering tailored solutions in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Project Management. We have a diverse, global team of consultants, all working remotely, embodying a collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven work culture.

As part of our growth and upcoming initiatives, we are searching for Senior Data Engineers to support future projects and platform modernization efforts across our client portfolio.


Position Summary


The Senior Data Engineer  will play a key role in supporting the transition and modernization of the client’s data platform. The position will focus on pipeline migration, operational stabilization, and the implementation of a dbt-based transformation framework  within a Snowflake environment.

This role will work closely with the Lead Data Architect and the client’s engineering team , participating in knowledge transfer sessions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain ELT pipelines  using Snowflake, Python, and Apache Airflow
  • Implement data ingestion and transformation logic  for batch and incremental pipelines
  • Convert existing SQL transformations into dbt models
  • Implement dbt testing frameworks  (schema, relationship, freshness tests)
  • Participate in pipeline walkthroughs and knowledge transfer sessions  with the existing team
  • Document data pipelines and operational procedures
  • Support the transition from vendor-managed pipelines to Data Meaning ownership
  • Monitor production pipelines and data workflows
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures and operational issues
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and operational reliability
  • Implement automated data validation and quality checks
  • Support the development of a data quality framework

Required Skills & Qualifications:


  • Advanced/fluent english
  • 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake
  • Experience working with Apache Airflow
  • Strong SQL (advanced)  skills
  • Strong Python  programming skills
  • Experience building: ELT pipelines, Data warehouse transformations, Batch and incremental, pipelines, Data ingestion pipelines
  • Experience working in cloud environments (AWS preferred)


Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing dbt
  • Experience with data platform migrations
  • Experience with data pipeline performance optimization

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento do Agronegócio.


Detalhes do projeto

Atuação em cliente do segmento de agronegócio (trading de commodities agrícolas), em um ambiente SAP S/4HANA, com utilização do módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management). O profissional fará parte de uma operação em modelo AMS (Application Management Services), com foco em suporte, sustentação e melhorias contínuas, interagindo com demais áreas.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar no suporte funcional (nível L1/L2) ao módulo SAP ACM;
  • Apoiar na análise de erros;
  • Realizar validação de dados e troubleshooting funcional;
  • Apoiar na execução de testes funcionais (unitários e integrados);

  • Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com usuários e equipe técnica.

  • Inglês intermediário.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer


We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, PySpark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure DevOps.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, PySpark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience.
  • Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption.
  • Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness.
  • Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries.
  • Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across GitHub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys.
  • For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines.


Requirements

  • Strong handson experience with: Python, PySpark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
  • Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
  • Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
  • Strong working experience with Azure DevOps, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
  • English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.


If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

title: Motion Graphics Editor
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,100 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly creative Motion Graphics Editor/Designer to create standout performance content across a diverse portfolio of leading consumer brands.


This is a hands-on thinker/doer role for someone who can design, edit, and animate polished creative in a fast-moving environment. The right person is not just a strong editor, but someone with real motion design ability, strong visual instincts, and a sharp eye for layout, typography, pacing, and UI-driven storytelling. You should be comfortable creating elevated, design-forward work that feels intentional, modern, and performance-minded.


You will work closely with their internal teams and external stakeholders to develop digital and social creative across platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and more. The ideal candidate understands direct response marketing, knows how to balance speed with craft, and is eager to push creative quality while staying aligned to performance goals.


What You’ll Do:

  • Create high-quality motion graphics with a strong design sensibility, including typography, layout, compositing, transitions, and UI-based animation
  • Build polished ad creative that blends brand storytelling with direct response best practices
  • Review footage and produce edits with strong narrative structure, pacing, and shot selection
  • Quickly assemble edits, iterate on concepts, and implement feedback from clients and internal teams under tight deadlines
  • Design and animate visual systems, graphics, and screen/UI moments that make creative feel elevated and intentional
  • Manage media and organize assets across Google Drive, Slack, Notion, and Asana
  • Quality control exports to ensure all deliverables meet creative standards, technical specs, brand guidelines, and deadlines
  • Complete and transfer final deliverables to clients and stakeholders accurately and on time


What You’ll Need:

  • 2–5 years of experience in motion design, video editing, and digital creative, ideally within a DTC agency or other fast-paced performance marketing environment
  • Advanced motion graphics skills with a strong design eye — this role requires someone who can create polished, high-end work, not just basic animation
  • Strong visual taste and attention to detail across typography, layout, composition, pacing, and overall creative polish
  • Experience designing and animating UI-inspired or screen-based visuals is strongly preferred
  • High proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially After Effects and Premiere Pro
  • Strong understanding of post-production workflows, visual storytelling, and how to make creative feel premium while still performance-oriented
  • Comfortable working from scripts, briefs, or loose direction while maintaining a high level of craft and creative consistency
  • Strong understanding of social platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and what makes content perform in each environment
  • A sharp sense of culture, trends, and creative strategy, with the ability to turn insights into engaging, high-performing work
  • Strong English communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a proactive, self-directed approach


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to create high-impact, performance-driven creative for leading consumer brands in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Analista de suporte de TI
description:
Sobre a vaga


Somos uma empresa de prestação de serviços de TI, gestão de infraestrutura e consultoria, localizada em Caieiras-SP.

Estamos buscando um Analista de Suporte Pleno para atuar no time de suporte técnico, garantindo a operação eficiente e segura da infraestrutura de nossos clientes.

Você será responsável por manter a base operacional de TI estável e escalável, contribuindo diretamente para a produtividade das empresas clientes.

A posição envolve administração de sistemas, redes e ambientes Microsoft, além de suporte a melhorias e rotinas operacionais.

O atendimento a usuários será parte fundamental do dia a dia, assim como eventuais implantações e manutenções de ambientes de TI.

Se você é proativo, dinâmico, tem uma mentalidade de solução de problemas e capacidade de implementar melhorias nos serviços e processos de TI e ver usuários e clientes satisfeitos, esta é a chance perfeita para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Service Desk, Suporte N1/N2, Gestão e Projetos.

  • Atendimento presencial e remoto a usuários finais e VIP, garantindo agilidade e qualidade na resolução de incidentes.
  • Registrar atividades de atendimento na plataforma MSP, ITSM, Service Desk (ferramenta em inglês).
  • Seguir processos de gestão de mudanças (GMUD) e incidentes em conformidade com as boas práticas da ITIL;
  • Elaborar e analisar relatórios gerenciais de disponibilidade, desempenho, capacidade (KPIs e SLAs);
  • Elaborar e atualizar diagramas e topologias do ambiente de TI;
  • Elaborar e atualizar procedimentos e documentação na base de conhecimento das ferramentas de Service Desk;
  • Analisar e recomendar melhorias contínuas para o ambiente de TI dos nossos clientes.
  • Conhecimento básico em infraestrutura física (cabeamento estruturado, fibra óptica, nobreak, organização de racks, etc)
  • Gestão de contas, licenciamento e segurança em ambiente Microsoft 365, sharepoint, EntraID, Google Workspace;
  • Gerenciar rotinas diárias de backups e realizar testes de restauração
  • Aplicação técnica de janelas de atualização (Patch Management) e correção de falhas de segurança em sistemas operacionais e aplicações.
  • Monitorar (NOC), links, disponibilidade e desempenho (Zabbix e PRTG)
  • Interagir com fornecedores e suporte externo (operadoras, assistência técnica, aluguel de equipamentos, compras e outros)
  • Realizar a montagem de kits para novos colaboradores (onboarding) e o recolhimento de equipamentos de colaboradores desligados (offboarding).
  • Controlar o estoque de equipamentos e suprimentos de informática, gerenciar e realizar requisições de compras de TI
  • Apoiar a liderança na proposição e implementação de melhorias na experiência de trabalho dos colaboradores, utilizando a tecnologia como facilitador
  • Preparar apresentações e relatórios gerenciais mensais em PowerPoint e Excel (gráficos) para apresentar para gerentes e diretores.
  • Administração de servidores físicos e virtuais (Hyper-V, AWS, Google Cloud) baseados em ambientes Microsoft Windows Server
  • Administração de ecossistema Microsoft (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, File Server, DFS, NPS entre outros recursos).
  • Conhecimento básico / intermediário em Linux
  • Noções de scripting (PowerShell ou Shell Script) para automação de tarefas rotineiras.
  • Administração de ativos de rede (LAN, WAN, VLANs) e protocolos de comunicação, incluindo VPN, MPLS e soluções de SD-WAN.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares);
  • Soluções de Wi-Fi corporativo (Unifi, Ubiquiti e similares)
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de Antivírus Bitdefender (Gravity Zone) e EDR, XDR;
  • Aplicar políticas de segurança da informação e monitorar constantemente, proativamente.
  • Gestão de Firewall (PFsense, Fortinet, Sonicwall ou similares)


Requisitos e qualificações.

  • Curso superior em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência em administração de redes e conectividade.
  • Experiência em ambientes virtualizados.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de segurança de rede.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de backup;
  • Inglês nível intermediário.


Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade: Capacidade de antecipar problemas e propor soluções inovadoras;
  • Perfil analítico: Capacidade de diagnosticar falhas e propor otimizações;
  • Boa comunicação: clareza na interação com usuários e equipes técnicas;
  • Trabalho em equipe: Colaboração com diferentes áreas de TI e negócios;
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de gerenciar prioridades e executar tarefas com eficiência.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens com CNH
  • Fácil acesso a Caieiras-SP

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Analytics Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.


What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu products membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.


As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

Our client operates the #1 AI Agent platform and is one of the fastest-growing AI companies globally (just behind ChatGPT/OpenAI and DeepSeek). They’ve already reached over 100 million users in a very short time, with a clear path toward 500 million next.


The company has built the world’s most advanced AI Agent content platform, enabling safe and ethical AI at massive scale.


They’ve also raised an unusually large seed round from prominent investors after rigorous due diligence, with a major Series A expected.


The company is fully remote  and operates in a fast-paced startup / scale-up environment with real ownership. They are now hiring their first Founding Performance Marketing Managers (Junior to Mid level).


The Role:

  • Hands-on Performance Marketing role scaling user acquisition for a high-traffic B2C AI platform at global scale
  • Work closely with CMO, product, creative, and data teams to scale, optimize, and stabilize paid acquisition channels
  • Own campaign execution end-to-end (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, ASA, Native), including creative testing, funnel iteration, and budget scaling
  • Reporting directly to the CMO, working alongside other senior growth / UA marketers
  • Startup / scale-up experience in fast-paced consumer environments strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical mindset (ROAS, CAC, LTV, cohorts) and ability to translate performance data into creative and funnel improvements is essential
  • Tech Stack: Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Snapchat, ASA, GA4, Voluum, tracking & attribution tools, internal dashboards, and automation tools


Why join?

  • Total compensation up to 60,000 EUR
  • Regular salary reviews and potential stock in future
  • Flexible contract models  (B2B or permanent)
  • Elite 100% remote  team with backgrounds from Tier-1 tech companies
  • One of the fastest-scaling AI companies globally, with massive real-world adoption
  • With so much still to be built, your work will have direct, visible impact
  • As the company scales rapidly, your career will scale with it
  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and events
  • Health & Wellness Support
  • Brand-new company laptop
  • Co-working space budget
  • High ownership in a mission-critical role
  • Opportunity to help scale a platform from 100M → 500M+ users and beyond
  • AI tools access: Premium ChatGPT, Cursor, Hugging Face, and more


To apply, please send your CV to


Baldur Connect is acting as a Recruitment Agency in relation to this vacancy. Baldur Connect is committed to being an equal opportunities employer and encourages applications from candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity status.

title: Arquiteto de soluções
description:
Sobre a vaga:

Buscamos uma pessoa Arquiteta de Soluções para atuar em iniciativas estratégicas no setor de energia, conectando negócio, tecnologia e parceiros. Essa posição será responsável por desenhar e evoluir arquiteturas escaláveis para produtos e plataformas que suportam operações complexas como mercado livre, geração distribuída e integração com agentes reguladores, garantindo eficiência, resiliência e inovação contínua.


Responsabilidades:

✔ Atuar como ponte entre negócio, tecnologia e parceiros, traduzindo necessidades em soluções escaláveis

✔ Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de referência alinhadas a princípios cloud-native, event-driven e API-first

✔ Liderar a governança de arquitetura, estabelecendo padrões, boas práticas e diretrizes (segurança, custos, observabilidade e resiliência)

✔ Apoiar squads em discovery, refinamentos e decisões técnicas críticas

✔ Projetar soluções resilientes para integração com sistemas internos, parceiros e agentes do setor (ex: CCEE, Aneel)

✔ Avaliar novas tecnologias com foco em geração de valor e otimização de custos (FinOps)

✔ Atuar em iniciativas estruturantes como plataformas de dados, integração e automação de processos

✔ Garantir práticas de segurança (Security by Design) e conformidade regulatória

✔ Promover observabilidade ponta a ponta e estratégias de confiabilidade (SRE)

✔ Apoiar a evolução da plataforma de APIs e integrações, incluindo governança e ciclo de vida

✔ Influenciar decisões técnicas e disseminar conhecimento


Requisitos:

✔ Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas

✔ Experiência sólida como Arquiteto(a) de Soluções ou em papel equivalente

✔ Vivência em ambientes complexos, distribuídos e orientados a produto/plataforma

✔ Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas, microsserviços e event-driven (EDA)

✔ Domínio de design de APIs (REST, Async APIs, versionamento e segurança)

✔ Experiência com integração de sistemas (REST, mensageria, streaming)

✔ Conhecimento em DDD, design patterns e boas práticas de desenvolvimento

✔ Experiência com cloud pública (AWS, Azure ou GCP)

✔ Conhecimento em Kubernetes e ecossistema cloud-native

✔ Experiência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Pulumi ou similares)

✔ Vivência com CI/CD e automação de pipelines

✔ Experiência com API gateways

✔ Conhecimento em plataformas de dados e pipelines (ETL/ELT)

✔ Experiência com mensageria e streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, etc.)

✔ Noções de IA aplicada a negócios


Diferenciais:

➕ Pós-graduação em Tecnologia

➕ Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados (data lakes, data mesh, batch/streaming)

➕ Experiência no setor de energia (mercado livre, geração distribuída)

➕ Vivência com integrações com agentes como CCEE, distribuidoras e Aneel

➕ Experiência com iniciativas de modernização e transformação digital
